Name: The Return of Linus's Treehouse
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
There was a request on the forums to update [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5567]Seasonal Treehouse for Linus[/url] to work on 1.6 and the author left permissions open to fix/update so here we are!

This mod gives Linus a treehouse. It's seasonal, and configurable to be small or large on the inside! The tent is replaced by a giant tree, and dialogue has been edited to acknowledge his new living quarters.

This update does NOT include the original recolor options; however, the issue with Looking for Love being incompatible [i]should [/i]be resolved. And YES, it's compatible with SVE!

Credit goes to djbassi for the original, and a special shout out to Esca for helping me figure out Linus's positioning! 

Enjoy!
